{{Quote|Ah, cleaning droids...finally. Don't waste any time, get to work.|This clone talking to the demolition droids|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>}}
A '''clone''' served as a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] with the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Before the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] planned to [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|bomb the Coruscant power generator]], this [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock trooper]] was on patrol at the [[Docks under the derrick major/Legends|docks under the derrick major]]. He was relieved when he saw the [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]], which were disguised as Sweeper Droids, arriving on the docks to clean and told them to get to work immediately.

==Behind the scenes==
This clone trooper was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].
